newsitem.title: CHINA: Inmates' wages top Beijing's minimum wage - paper.
newsitem.headline: Inmates' wages top Beijing's minimum wage - paper.

text.p: State media have been trumpeting China's model prisons in recent weeks, and one newspaper crowed on Thursday that the average take-home pay of a group of inmates exceeded the minimum wage of workers in Beijing.
The average monthly salary plus bonus of a group of inmates at one unidentified prison was 260 yuan ($31) last April, the Procuratorial Daily said.
"(This) exceeds Beijing's minimum wage of 210 yuan ($25)," the newspaper said.
It did not say what kind of work the inmates were engaged in. The bonus that inmates receive varies monthly depending on how much work they do.
